notes:
REF-BM-02: Fetches title and description only; favicon and preview image are missing.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-07: List items show title, description, and tags, but no favicon.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and tags, but not note or URL.
REF-BM-14: Search does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is unsupported.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions are implemented.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection bulk action is implemented.
REF-BM-22: Results are always sorted by creation date descending; no selectable sort key exists.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is absent.
REF-BM-27: There is no reversible archive operation distinct from permanent deletion.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
